title: Site document, version 1
description: What every page of a data-driven site shares (DP8, DR3): its name and title pattern, the home and not-found pages, the navigation, the header and footer blocks, the words no one page holds, the layout every page starts from, the page transition and old addresses that move. Pages are page documents (page.schema.json); `SiteView` from `@design-library/core/render` draws them. Pure data: no markup, styles or code.

id.description: A short name for the site, used where the renderer needs a key (stored choices, such as the colour scheme).

title.description: The site's name, as `{site}` in the title pattern.

titlePattern.description: The window title of every page: `{page}` is the page's title and `{site}` the site's. The home page shows the site's title alone unless its page document sets `windowTitle`.

home.description: The id of the page at `/`.

notFound.description: The id of the page shown for an address no page has. Without it, the renderer shows `strings.notFound` with a link home.

navigation.description: The site's places, in order. A `site-header` block without `places` takes them, and the place the current page belongs to (its `current`, else the first part of its route) is marked.

header.description: Blocks in every page's header (usually one `site-header`).

footer.description: Blocks in every page's footer (usually one `site-footer`).

layout.description: The layout every page starts from; a page's own `layout` and `settings` win.

transition.description: How one page replaces another (Router `transition`, IP30). Reduced motion always swaps at once.

again.description: A link to the page already shown: does nothing (`none`, default) or glides back to the top (`top`), as a header link to the current page does on many sites (Router `again`, MP2).

aliases.description: Old or extra addresses and where each goes (DP16), such as { "/home": "/" }. A `:name` part matches any one part and carries over ("/events/:id": "/readings/:id"); an `https://` target leaves the site. The address is replaced, so Back skips it.

derive.description: Values worked out from the collections when the site loads (DP14), by name; content reads one with { "derived": "book-count" }. Each is one of: `count` (how many items, or with `field` how many distinct values of it: a number), `distinct` (the distinct values of `field`, sorted: a list) or `group` (one { "value", "count" } per distinct value of `field`, sorted by value: a list). Each may narrow the items with `where`, as a list binding's (collection.schema.json `$defs.binding`). Adding an item updates every value that counts it.

strings.description: Words the renderer needs that no one page holds.

notFound.description: Shown for an unknown address when the site has no `notFound` page.

home.description: The link back to the home page.

unconfirmed.description: The phrase shown for each kind of value not yet confirmed (DP4), such as { "speaker": "Speaker to confirm" }.

scheme.description: Words for a colour scheme control (`SchemeControl` `words`).

route.description: A site address: `/`, or lowercase parts after a slash.

pattern.description: A site address whose parts may be `:name` (any one part).

component.description: A core layout (`SiteLayout`) or one the site registers.

settings.description: The layout component's options; for SiteLayout `width` (`wide`, `reading`) and `opening` (`spaced`, `flush`).

derivation.description: One derived value (`derive`): exactly one of `count`, `distinct` or `group`, naming the collection.

count.description: How many items of this collection (with `field`, how many distinct values of it).

distinct.description: The distinct values of `field` across this collection's items, sorted.

group.description: One { "value", "count" } per distinct value of `field`, sorted by value.

field.description: A dotted item path that follows references; a list field counts each of its values.

block.description: A core block (blocks.schema.json, by its `type`) or a site's own, namespaced (`shop.price-list`).
